Original accepted external value/owner/drain oracle; V97 ingress commit distinct from decoder done.
candidate_contract: IV115.3: early coherent header preparation and one private tile-write slot with visible forwarding preserve initial V115 edges; unchanged registered E/E+1 command API; helper preparation +2 edges per normal tile, ingress SELECT +8 per compressed packet, scratch reservation E/commit E+3 plus exact-cycle read-tag preparation. limits: Actual successful component and V97 transport fences compared against initial V115 with identical corpus/seeds and canonical bytes; negative frames and later abort/reset retries excluded from latency distributions.
First byte is first accepted decoder byte; transport start-to-report includes earlier command and finite FIFO prefill, and is reported separately.
Zero matched fence deltas are bounded observations, not proof of every public value on every possible input cycle; separate focused pair checks retain their own scope.
The refined header sum and tile-write slot are intended to preserve initial V115 external cycles; every observed difference is retained rather than ignored.
Local decoder done/last canonical pixel exclude complete C2/HUD/seal validation and parent publication. The separate live-parent partition is not included here.
100/125-MHz conversion is conditional arithmetic; achieved route clocks, full-system latency, ESP32 execution and sustained hardware30fps remain separate.
Fitting a33.333ms conditional service interval is not hardware30fps; strictly under10ms requires fewer than1.25million cycles at assumed125MHz.
